newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss set terms on 3-month money market claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss set terms on 3-month money market claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government allocated 1,119.8 million Swiss francs in its 3.372 series of three-month money market claims, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue was priced at 99.623 and yields 1.481 percent per annum. Settlement is February 6.
The previous issue of 12-month series A.371 claims, paid for on January 1, raised 450.7 million francs and was priced at 98.291 to yield 1.72 percent annually.
